description: Defines the data structures, macros, and function prototypes for a C dynamic strings library (SDSLib 2.0), used in Redis for efficient string handling.

methods.name: sdslen
methods.description: Returns the length of the SDS string based on its header type.

methods.name: sdsavail
methods.description: Returns the available space in the SDS string buffer.

methods.name: sdssetlen
methods.description: Sets the length of the SDS string.

methods.name: sdsinclen
methods.description: Increments the length of the SDS string.

methods.name: sdsalloc
methods.description: Returns the total allocated size of the SDS string buffer.

methods.name: sdssetalloc
methods.description: Sets the allocated size of the SDS string buffer.
